ui_bugs.issue: Three TouchableOpacity controls in Case Details ASA inline edit used only data-testid (no testID), so on RN-web the data-testid attribute was NOT forwarded to the DOM and the controls were untestable (and would have been hard to target in general). Fixed by adding testID alongside data-testid on edit-medical-asa_class (line 2891), asa-edit-option-{cls} (line 2902), and asa-edit-save (line 2911).

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated console error 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' fires on /procedures/{id}?edit=true and in new-procedure Existing Implant flow. Likely a stray whitespace/empty string being rendered inside a <View> (not inside a <Text>). Not blocking functionality, but should be hunted down by the main agent. Reference: /app/frontend/app/procedures/[id].tsx and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/new-procedure.tsx. iter-453 ASA components themselves looked clean on inspection; the warnings predate ASA selection but appear more frequently in Existing-Implant flow.

critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/procedures/[id].tsx — Several TouchableOpacity controls (edit-medical-asa_class, asa-edit-option-{cls}, asa-edit-save, and cancel button nearby) relied on data-testid without a matching testID. RN-web silently drops unknown DOM-ish props on TouchableOpacity, so these were effectively untestable. Pattern-wise, every new interactive element should declare BOTH testID and data-testid (as AsaClassificationSection.tsx already does).

rca_of_issue: RCA for inline-edit testID gap: In React Native Web, the standard way to produce a DOM data-testid is to pass the React Native testID prop; TouchableOpacity does not forward arbitrary data-* props from JSX to the underlying <div>. Three TouchableOpacity components added in iter-453 for the ASA inline edit path used only data-testid, which React treats as an unknown prop on the composite component. Playwright selectors therefore returned null even though the buttons were visually present and clickable. Fix: add testID alongside data-testid (consistent with AsaClassificationSection.tsx pattern). Reproduction: open /procedures/{editable_id}?edit=true as admin, inspect DOM of the ASA row — pre-fix the pencil TouchableOpacity has no data-testid attribute; post-fix it does.
